Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Inference pricing deck & estimate — follow-up

Hi Alex —

Great to meet on the call earlier. As promised, attaching the pricing deck and a preliminary estimate based on the usage profile we discussed (30M tokens/month, mix of generate + embeddings). Highlights: 

- Proposed plan: Dedicated small pool (4 A100-equivalent GPUs) with burst capacity for peak inference.
- Estimated monthly cost (net of initial commit credit): $28,500 — see estimate_ACME_2026.xlsx attached.
- Recommended optimizations: use 8-bit quantized variant for lower-cost batches, enable prefix caching for chat-heavy flows.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Confirm priority/timing for Q3 pilot
2) Share any procurement or security hoops (I copied Priya for procurement alignment)
3) If helpful, I can run a 20–30 minute walkthrough of the deck and line-item estimate next week.

Attachments: pricing_deck_v2.pdf, estimate_ACME_2026.xlsx
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-pricing-deck-v2
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-45

If you want, here are two proposed slots for a quick walk-through: Tue 6/8 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 6/9 14:00–14:30 PT. I can also keep this async if you prefer — happy to answer questions by email.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
